text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed 0.45 percent up on Friday's close, but trade volumes declined, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 442.80 points, up from 440.81 on Friday. Total volume was 329,150 dinars against 632,734 dinars.

Milk firm Tunisie Lait gained 1.9 dinar to 22.94 dinars. Compagnie d'Assurances et de Reassurances Tuniso-Europeenne was up 1.06 dinar to 36.94. Coca and beer bottler Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis gained one dinar to 75.5 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN was up 0.5 dinar to 32 dinars.
Banque de l'Habitat BHH.TN rose 0.27 dinar to 15 dinars.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing LEAS.TN fell 0.36 dinar to 30.24 dinars despite announcement that its pretax profit during the first half of 1997 was up 50 percent compared to the same period last year.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was down 0.2 dinar to 13.7.
Union Bancaire du Commerce et de l'Industrie edged lower 0.18 dinar to 39.82 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air declined 0.1 dinar to 18.5 dinars.
